_doc: CANONICAL joint table for Zang. Shared contract between ai_stack (sim, planner, safety, RL) and firmware (generated into firmware/zang_p4/components/robot_def/include/robot_joints.h by firmware/tools/gen_robot_joints.py; never edit that header by hand). Angles on the wire and everywhere in software are MODEL joint angles (MJCF/URDF frame, radians in code, centidegrees int16 on the wire). The firmware alone maps model angle -> servo ticks with its per-servo calibration (sign, zero offset, ticks per turn) stored in NVS. 'index' = wire order (ZLink JOINT arrays). servo_id = bus ID, PROVISIONAL until the harness is wired. Limits marked placeholder come from zang_description/tools/build.py (+-90 deg) and must be replaced by measured mechanical stops.
name: zang

servo._doc: Serial bus servo, same DS protocol family as Zing (FF FF id len instr addr data chk). Resolution / range / max baud are NOT yet confirmed from a datasheet: placeholders below follow Zing's measured DS servos (270 deg over 4096 ticks).

limits_doc: Per-group motion limits used by the safety stage (and mirrored by the firmware's last-line limiter). vmax rad/s, amax rad/s^2. Placeholders until the servo is identified.
